articles.title: Are banks, USPS and stock markets open on Columbus Day?
articles.summary: The stock market is open on Columbus Day, but banking, mail and some other services will be closed for the holiday.
articles.body:
Columbus Day, also known as Indigenous Peoples Day, may be an official federal holiday, but it's not consistently observed across the U.S., according to the Pew Research Center.

Falling on the second Monday in October, the holiday creates a three-day weekend for workers whose employers observe it, including federal employees and some state workers, Pew found.

But a push to shift recognition away from explorer Christopher Columbus and instead honor North America's original inhabitants means the holiday isn't as widely observed as it once was.

Since Oct. 12 is a federal holiday, some services and businesses will be closed. Here's what to know about what is open and closed on Columbus Day/Indigenous Peoples Day.

Yes, Monday, Oct. 12, is a federal holiday, which means that U.S. government offices will be closed and federal workers have the day off.

Is the stock market open on Columbus Day?

Yes, the stock market is open on Columbus Day, with neither the New York Stock Exchange nor the Nasdaq market observing it as a holiday.

The stock market will be open during its regular working hours on Monday from 9:30 a.m.-4 p.m. ET.

No, the U.S. Postal Service observes Columbus Day as a holiday, which means there will be no regular residential or business mail delivery. All USPS offices will also be closed.

It's best to check with your bank, as some are open while others observe the holiday.

JPMorgan Chase said that its branches will be open on Oct. 12, but will treat the day as a holiday for online transactions. That means customers can't schedule transactions to occur on Columbus Day, and repeating transactions were processed on the preceding business day.

Many other banks are closed on Columbus Day, including Wells Fargo and Bank of America .

Yes, Costco is open for business today, as Columbus Day isn't among the seven holidays the discount chain observes.

Walmart is also open on Columbus Day, with stores open during regular hours, according to the retailer's website.

articles.title: I get paid £120,000 a year to make social media videos go viral
articles.summary: Social media "clippers" make short, vertical videos that appear on the likes of Instagram and TikTok.
articles.body:
Eknoor Singh says he only needs his mobile phone and a decent internet connection to earn more than £120,000 a year.

The 22-year-old Londoner is a professional "clipper". He is paid by clients to make short, vertical videos for social media, in the hope of them going viral.

"The more views a clip gets, the more money I make," he says.

The way it typically works is that the client - who could be anyone from a clothing brand to a record label, movie studio, podcaster or influencer - has a longer video that the clipper watches first.

He or she then makes 30 to 60-second clips of what they consider to be the best bit or bits, and uploads them to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok or other platforms.

The idea is that the clippers, who are typically aged from 16 to 25, will have a better understanding of what will connect with that demographic, and get the short videos as many views as possible.

With clippers able to earn up to $3 (£2.30) per 1,000 views across platforms, it can be very lucrative if a particular clip does take off.

Singh says he got hooked on clipping last year when he made $300 from posting a short video of popstar Dua Lipa on Instagram.

"I was like, 'OK, this is a lot of money for simply posting a video.' I instantly knew how lucrative it could be."

Now he says he is earning "at least £10,000 a month".

He adds that he looks for clips that are funny, quick to watch and engaging, such as a short video he made in May of Sabrina Carpenter's reaction to having the tails of her dress stepped on at the Met Gala in New York. Singh did not reveal who the client was.

For 24-year-old clipper Ethan Weems from Wichita, Kansas, it's a lucrative side hustle to his other video-making work. He says he makes "at least $1,000 a month" from clipping.

He does this by making short videos for YouTuber and podcaster Caleb Hammer, who is best known for hosting a show called Financial Audit, which analyses the personal finances of his guests.

Weems says clipping helps him make a living from home – giving him more time to spend with his wife and one-year-old son. "I don't want that typical nine-to-five job where I have to go into an office every day," he says.

Yet while some clippers can make good money, social media consultant Lia Haberman cautions that there are very few of them. "It mirrors the creator economy more broadly. The vast majority make little to nothing," she says.

Meanwhile, streaming industry analyst Devin Nash says it's easy to underestimate the time required to make clipping a success. He warns that successful clippers must "watch hours and hours of content, and they just live in that world".

Connecting clippers with their prospective clients are a number of intermediary websites, where available video jobs are listed.

These range from pages on general online forums such as Reddit and Discord, to dedicated clipping sites such as Clipping Culture, Vyro, Whop and Kick.

The latter websites take a fee from the companies wanting the work done. Clipping Culture lists clients including Capital Records, Universal Music Group and HBO Max.

For firms such as these, hiring a teenager or 20-something working from his or her bedroom is far cheaper than paying for traditional adverts on social media, and likely to be more effective in terms of getting eyeballs.

That's the experience of Boxabl, a Las Vegas-based firm that makes modular homes. "I think we've done probably a billion views [of clips] so far," says founder Galiano Tiramani, who features in many of the company's videos.

In the UK, Jimmy McLoughlin, a former Downing Street adviser and now host of the Jimmy's Jobs of the Future podcast, has also embraced clips.

"The clips are almost like trailers for the main events," he says. For instance, a recent podcast with Prime Minister Andy Burnham "had close to 50,000 long plays, but in terms of clips, it's done millions".

Evan Stanfield, the founder and boss of Clipping Culture, is himself just 21. He set up the business last year after dropping out of the University of Kansas.

Stanfield says that the website connects brands to more than 340,000 clippers from all over the world. He has a simple theory for the popularity of short videos: "People's attention spans are getting shorter and shorter."

He adds that making the clips is a young person's game because "they're most of the consumers of short-form videos".

Back in London, Eknoor Singh says he is "kind of clipping non-stop", wherever he is.

"I could be anywhere. I could go on holiday and make money."

articles.title: Heating oil customers face tough winter despite shake-up promise
articles.summary: Heating oil customers facing soaring bills are promised better regulation of the sector by the government.
articles.body:
Heating oil customers facing soaring bills have been promised better regulation of the sector by the government.

Ministers say they will tighten up rules, promote competition and give customers clearer compensation routes if things go wrong. Minimum order levels, set for some customers, will be reviewed.

With prices close to having doubled in the past year, some campaigners have called for heating oil customers to benefit from the same cap as regular, variable gas and electricity tariffs in England, Scotland and Wales.

But there is no sign of the government proposing such a change, nor when the stricter rules will take effect.

Ministers said they would work with industry to "develop a regulatory regime for the heating oil market, protecting consumers and promoting competition".

In the meantime, oil users have been offered discounts on heat pumps, a code of practice is in place, and industry practices setting minimum order volumes at 500 litres for some consumers will be reviewed. Domestic tanks typically hold between 1,000 and 2,000 litres.

The government said this had left some people having to pay for more heating oil than they might need.

Buy now or wait and hope? Families face gamble on heating oil

Prices have soared since the start of the US-Israeli war with Iran. In March, the government announced a support package worth £53m for low-income families who use heating oil.

The funding is distributed by local authorities, which set their own criteria for eligibility.

A subsequent inquiry by the UK's competition watchdog, the Competition and Markets Authority, found that 1,700 households were forced to "re-order at significantly higher prices or go without fuel" after the war broke out, costing them up to £350.

But those whose orders were cancelled and prices raised were told they were entitled to compensation.

The government has now announced it will accept the CMA's recommendation to strengthen regulation in the sector.

Energy minister Polly Billington said: "Thousands of heating oil customers felt they had nowhere to turn when they paid the price of rising oil and gas costs earlier this year.

"We won't accept that. Energy is an essential good and people should not have to think twice about whether they're protected in the market. That's why we will reform the sector."

Nick, a heating oil customer from West Suffolk, told the BBC's Your Voice that "off-grid households remain a major policy blind spot" for the government.

"Any protection from UK government for domestic heating oil users will be very welcome, providing this is for all domestic heating oil users," the 28-year-old said.

He rents a three-bedroom home with his partner. He said they had seen prices more than double in a year, to quotes of 111p per litre.

"Heating my home is now no longer another household bill, but almost an investment," he said.

He called on tax cuts for customers, or the extension of the price cap to heating oil - a demand also made by charity National Energy Action.

Tim Buckman, chief executive of price comparison site Boiler Juice, told the BBC he wants stronger protections for consumers but the main problem was that heating oil is twice as expensive as it was before the war.

"Just putting regulation in place is not going to reduce the price for customers. What we would like to see is the VAT off heating oil or targeting that specifically."

Some 1.5 million households depend on heating oil, but they do not have the same consumer protections as electricity and gas customers.

However, energy regulator Ofgem, which sets the cap for standard variable tariffs, only covers England, Wales and Scotland.

Most heating oil customers are in Northern Ireland, where 60% of households rely on it, but where regulation is separate.

It is likely Ofgem will regulate heating oil in England, Scotland and Wales, and the UK government said it would "engage with the Northern Ireland Executive as they consider these recommendations in parallel".

articles.title: US archbishop says Catholics in army should not participate in firing squad
articles.summary: Archbishop Timothy Broglio says US plan to livestream Fort Hood attacker’s execution is contrary to church teachings.
articles.body:
United States Archbishop Timothy Broglio has urged Catholics who are members of the country’s armed forces not to take part in a planned public execution by firing squad, saying that it violates the teachings of the church.

Broglio released a strongly worded statement on Monday raising a series of concerns about the US military’s plan to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, a former army major who killed 13 people during a shooting attack at Fort Hood, Texas, in 2009.

“I oblige any Catholics assigned to the firing squad to request to be excused from this action contrary to the teaching of the Church,” Broglio said.

He also asked whether the US wants to “imitate the terrorists of this world and make a public spectacle of barbarically killing our adversaries”.

The plan to livestream the execution on December 3 was announced last week by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, who characterised the spectacle as deterrence.

“We’ll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it’s public, because people need to understand that there are serious consequences for these types of things,” Hegseth told the right-wing media outlet Real America’s Voice.

But the proposal has sparked backlash from lawmakers , rights groups and critics who warn that a publicly broadcast killing is not only unethical but could also be used as anti-US propaganda.

Hasan, now aged 56, was shot by the police during the 2009 Fort Hood attack and is now wheelchair-bound. Critics fear livestreaming Hasan’s death could turn him into a symbol for armed groups that may be hostile to the US.

Cardinal Blase J Cupich, the archbishop of Chicago, also condemned the plan to livestream the execution in a social media post on Monday, questioning the example it could set for children.

“Capital punishment is unacceptable in any case,” he said. “The planned broadcast of the taking of a life by firing squad is nothing short of performative barbarism. Do we really want our children, who will inevitably view it, exposed to the pornography of a state-sponsored slaying?”

Hegseth has said he wants the execution to take place at the same time and location as the 2009 shooting spree, and described using military members to carry out the death penalty.

“It hadn’t been since World War II since we’ve done that,” Hegseth said of the firing squad. “Well, I kind of like the mentality we had in World War II, which was win.”

The last US military execution by firing squad was of Eddie Slovik, who was accused of desertion in 1945. He was the only US soldier to have such a sentence carried out for abandoning his post.

In Monday’s statement, Broglio also questioned the reasoning behind putting service members on camera to carry out Hasan’s death. He hinted that it could harm the US military’s image abroad.

“The US military generally enjoys a good reputation in the world,” Broglio wrote. “Is there really a value to throwing them in the same boat with terrorists by broadcasting the image of the execution of a man in a wheel chair to the whole world?”

Without mentioning Hasan’s case specifically, Pope Leo also released a statement on Saturday condemning the death penalty.

“The death penalty is inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person,” he said in a social media post.

“The common good can be safeguarded and the requirements of justice can be met without recourse to capital punishment: effective systems of detention have been developed that protect citizens while at the same time do not completely deprive those who are guilty of the possibility of redemption.”

President Donald Trump , who oversaw an unprecedented spike in federal executions during his first term in office, has approved Hasan’s execution.

Still, on Saturday, he indicated that he has not decided whether to proceed with a livestream.

“There are two thoughts: Don’t show it and show it. Because, you know, by showing it, maybe other people won’t be doing what he did,” Trump told reporters. “I’ll make a decision.”

Since the start of his second term as president, Trump has pushed for the increased use of the federal death penalty. In April, he also approved additional methods to carry out the death penalty, including the firing squad.

In the past, Trump has also floated the death penalty as a punishment for crimes ranging from drug dealing to sedition, a term he has invoked against political rivals .

articles.title: 1 dead, others hurt at Six Flags Over Georgia as man fell from coaster, guests say
articles.summary: A person died and several others were injured at Six Flags Over Georgia on Monday, officials said, after witnesses reported seeing a man fall from a roller coaster.
articles.body: A person died and several others were injured at Six Flags Over Georgia on Monday, officials said, after witnesses reported seeing a man fall from a roller coaster. The Cobb County Department of Emergency Communications confirmed the death but did not provide additional details about the incident about 4 p.m. at the amusement park just outside Atlanta. Cobb County Police said multiple park-goers were injured, though it’s not clear exactly how. The department’s Major Crimes Unit is investigating. Witnesses who spoke to NBC affiliate WXIA of Atlanta said they saw a man fall from the Goliath roller coaster, and at least two people said they saw him strike parts of the ride before he hit the ground. “He fell and hit the car three different times,” a witness told the station. “We are deeply saddened by the guest incident at our park today. Our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with the guest’s family, friends, and loved ones,” a park spokesperson said in a statement. The spokesperson added that the park was providing support to guests and employees and that details would not be immediately released “out of respect for the family’s privacy.” Logan Conner said he was on the ride with his fiancé when he saw the man come out of his seat on Goliath. “The man started levitating in the air sideways,” he said. “We made direct eye contact with him.” A witness told WXIA that the man who fell had been sitting with a child. Video showed riders exiting the roller coaster after it paused mid-ride. Goliath, designed and built by Bolliger & Mabillard Consulting Engineers of Switzerland, opened in 2006 and features a drop of more than 200 feet, which places it in the category of hyper coaster. A Six Flags spokesperson said by email Monday night that it has temporarily closed similar rides at the company’s other North American locations “out of an abundance of caution.” Those rides include Raging Bull at Six Flags Great America; Goliath at Six Flags Magic Mountain; Nitro at Six Flags Great Adventure; Leviathan and Behemoth at Canada’s Wonderland; Fury 325 and Thunder Striker at Carowinds; and Orion and Diamondback at Kings Island, the spokesperson said. In September, Six Flags was named in multiple lawsuits after riders alleged to have suffered brain injuries on the X2 roller coaster at Six Flags Magic Mountain in Southern California. It includes 360-degree rotating seats, a 215-foot drop and sudden flips and rotations. That coaster has been closed since July 12, a day after attorney Christopher Bulone said one of the plaintiffs suffered catastrophic brain injury after a ride. Magic Mountain President Brian Oerding said in a Sept. 29 statement that X2 was being retired because “it’s the right thing to do” after guest confidence in its safety was affected. Six Flags Over Georgia is about 10 miles west of downtown Atlanta.

articles.title: Two deaths reported as Hurricane Simon, storm Rachel batter Mexico’s coast
articles.summary: Simon caps a Pacific season of record-breaking intensity, as deadly storms wreak havoc from Hawaii to Mexico.
articles.body:
At least two people have died in Mexico after Hurricane Simon and former tropical storm Rachel brought torrential rain and catastrophic flooding to Pacific coast communities.

At a Monday news briefing, Guerrero Governor Evelyn Salgado confirmed that a 71-year-old man had died during Hurricane Simon after a retaining wall collapsed under the weight of intense precipitation.

According to the Guerrero-based news agency IRZA, the man, identified by his family as Albino Moreno Jimenez, had been feeding his animals on the western outskirts of Chilpancingo when a wall came crashing down on him.

A second death was announced later in the day in the state of Baja California along Mexico’s western coast. There, Governor Marina del Pilar said that a young girl had died from the effects of what was once Hurricane Rachel, which peaked in early October as a Category 3 storm.

At least 10 more people remain missing in Baja California, according to the governor. Eight were reported missing in the city of Ensenada, on the Pacific coast, and two in the fishing town of San Felipe on the Gulf of California.

The figures remain preliminary, with local newspaper La Jornada reporting a higher death toll of two in Baja California and 11 missing.

Rachel made landfall in the Mexican state as a post-tropical cyclone, and its remnants have travelled north through southern California in the southwestern United States.

Hurricane Simon, meanwhile, has churned off the coast of Mexico since the weekend. By late Monday morning, it had weakened from a powerful Category 4 storm to a Category 2.

Its maximum sustained winds had slowed slightly to around 155km/h (100mph), according to the US National Hurricane Center. Its centre was about 115km west-southwest of Cabo Corrientes, a cape in the state of Jalisco, drifting west at 3km/h.

Forecasters predict Simon could make landfall on Thursday or Friday. Hurricane warnings remain in effect for western Mexico, which is vulnerable to landslides and deadly surf conditions as a result of the storm.

Experts warn the death toll from both storms could rise, and officials have called on residents to exercise caution amid the devastation wrought by downed trees, high winds and floodwaters.

The Spanish newspaper El Pais reported the death of a cliff diver, Juan Patines, who was killed in Mazatlan, the northwestern state of Sinaloa, after jumping into the sea on Saturday night.

According to Mexican media, the heavy surf hampered his efforts to return to shore amid dangerous coastal conditions associated with Hurricane Simon. Local authorities later halted cliff-diving at the site due to hazardous sea conditions.

Officials have yet to confirm whether his death was directly linked to Hurricane Simon.

Rachel and Simon have battered Mexico’s western coast as part of an extraordinary stretch of hurricane activity across the Pacific.

The northeastern and central Pacific Ocean has experienced a record storm season this year, fuelled in part by the El Nino weather phenomenon, which results in warming waters in parts of the region. Twenty-one named storms have been recorded in the Pacific so far.

On Sunday, Simon tipped the region to a historic high for accumulated cyclone energy (ACE), a metric of the combined strength and longevity of tropical storms. This year has already surpassed the previous high set in 2018.

The US island chain of Hawaii has been among the hardest-hit places. In August, Hurricane Lala unleashed ruinous flooding on Hawaii’s Big Island as a Category 1 storm, killing a 93-year-old woman and destroying some 100 homes, according to state officials.

A few weeks later, Hurricane Lowell , a Category 4 hurricane at its peak, struck the Hawaiian islands of Kauai and Niihau, where powerful winds, storm surge and flooding overwhelmed towns and roads.

Roughly 90 percent of Kauai’s power customers were plunged into darkness as a result of electricity outages. At least two deaths were linked to Lowell.

In late September, Hurricane Nolo brought another round of flooding and landslides to the Hawaiian islands, though it did not make landfall.

articles.title: 911 calls highlight confusion after the failed execution of Christa Pike
articles.summary: The recordings show precious minutes elapsed as officials and responders tried to figure out whether a request for emergency help in the execution chamber was legitimate.
articles.body: NASHVILLE, Tenn. — Emergency help for Christa Pike was delayed by confusion among first responders and Tennessee prison officials following her failed execution last month, according to 911 dispatch recordings. The recordings, obtained by The Associated Press through a public records request, show that precious minutes elapsed as officials and responders tried to figure out whether a request for emergency help in the execution chamber was legitimate. The first 911 call came in at 8:40 p.m. on Sept. 30, just over an hour after the attempted lethal injection got underway. It wasn’t until half an hour later that prison officials affirmed the call was legitimate and began letting responders through the prison gates. Pike, 50, was hospitalized after surviving two doses of pentobarbital as the state tried to execute her for the 1995 stabbing death of classmate Colleen Slemmer. She was 18 when she and her boyfriend tortured and killed Slemmer, becoming one of the youngest women to be sentenced to death. Pike was on a ventilator for several days and, at one point, her attorneys did not expect her to survive. She regained consciousness last Tuesday and began talking limitedly and walking with assistance, they said. Pike was discharged from the hospital and returned to the women’s prison where she was housed for 30 years, her lawyers said Saturday. Confusion began on the initial 911 call, in which a person whose name and title were redacted said they were at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution and had tried to execute someone, but she was still alive. The dispatcher asked for a code to verify that the call was legitimate, but the caller didn’t have one. “Per supervisors here at the DEC [Department of Emergency Communications] we have been informed it is a false call,” a dispatcher says at 9:03 p.m. “There is no medical assistance needed at Riverbend Prison.” Four minutes later, a responder reported: “Somebody is outside the gate at the prison telling us that it’s real and demanding us to go in. They say they are some sort of state official. I need somebody to get out to the gate and talk to those people.” As emergency responders worked to verify the call, they were in touch with representatives of the prison’s Central Control, who said they “would have been the ones to call in and they did not make that call,” according to a recording time-stamped at 9:07 p.m. A few minutes later, Central Control confirmed the call was legitimate and cleared the way for responders to enter at 9:11 p.m. The Tennessee Department of Correction has not said what went wrong in the attempted execution. Medical experts have raised a few possibilities that could explain how Pike was able to survive, including potential drug quality issues and the placement of IV lines causing the drug to pool in her tissue.

articles.title: Eric Trump trashes ABC over 'bulls--- hit piece,' backs call for FCC probe into revised story
articles.summary: Eric Trump backed Sen. Bernie Moreno's call for an FCC investigation into ABC News' erroneous report linking his family to Anduril Pentagon contracts.
articles.body: Eric Trump expressed support for a federal probe into a botched story from ABC News about his family's business dealings with defense contractor Anduril Industries. Sen. Bernie Moreno, R-Ohio, called on the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to investigate what led to an erroneous report published on the Disney-owned network's website last week with the headline "Trump sons' investments have won billions in Pentagon contracts since his election." The report was initially deleted without explanation and then republished with a correction. "Thank you @berniemoreno — can’t wait to participate!" Eric Trump reacted Monday on X. ABC NEWS DELETES 'HIT PIECE' ON TRUMP SONS' PENTAGON-LINKED INVESTMENTS WITHOUT EXPLANATION "You can’t publish a bulls**t hit-piece, let it spread and go viral, then delete it 24 hours later, under the cover of darkness with no explanation or apology. Who approved it? Has the author been fired? @ABC owes us answers," he continued. In a letter to FCC Chairman Brendan Carr, Moreno demanded accountability for the network's report and questioned whether ABC News violated its obligations as a broadcaster. "Thus, I urge the Commission to open a formal investigation into ABC News's political hit job. We must know who signed off on the publication of this false story, who may have asked to profit from the attack, and whether ABC News's conduct violated its obligations as a licensee," Moreno said. DISNEY SUES FCC OVER ‘RETALIATORY CAMPAIGN AGAINST ABC,’ SEEKS TO BLOCK EARLY RENEWAL PROCEEDINGS The letter followed ABC News' decision to remove a report examining investments tied to both Eric Trump and Donald Trump Jr. The original Wednesday article claimed companies connected to the president's sons had secured billions in government contracts, including through venture capital firm 1789 Capital. Moreno specifically challenged the original report's characterization of Anduril's financing, arguing that the network had misrepresented the company's investment activity and unfairly associated the Trump family with federal contracting decisions. The controversy centered on ABC News' original claim that 1789 Capital, where Trump Jr. serves as a partner, acquired a major strike in Anduril through a $2.5 billion investment. The figure instead represented Anduril's broader fundraising round, while 1789 Capital's investment was approximately $50 million. CLICK HERE FOR THE LATEST MEDIA AND CULTURE NEWS ABC News republished a substantially revised article Friday, acknowledging errors involving investments, government contracts and the chronology of events. The updated version also clarified that Trump Jr. does not serve on the firm's investment decision-making committee. The new headline reads, "New shipyard announced amid earlier Democratic concerns about potential conflicts of interest," though the original reporter's byline was replaced with "ABC News." A 1789 source told Fox News Digital that an ABC News journalist involved with the story defended it over the phone before the story itself was deleted. Semafor similarly reported Sunday that editors initially stood by the published story, according to emails between ABC News investigative reporter Nathan Lee, who authored the original story, and an Anduril spokesperson. That would contradict the network's notion to other media reporters that the story was published "prematurely." ABC News did not immediately respond to requests for comment. articles.title: One dead, several others hurt on Six Flags rollercoaster in Georgia
articles.summary: Aerial footage at the park after the incident shows a stuck rollercoaster with riders being helped off.
articles.body:
One person has died and several others were injured after an incident on a rollercoaster at an amusement park in the state of Georgia.

The Cobb County Police Department said it was investigating the fatality at Six Flags Over Georgia, about 15 miles (24km) from Atlanta, according to the BBC's news partner CBS.

Police did not specify what ride was involved, but aerial footage from news helicopters showed the Goliath rollercoaster stopped midway, with riders being helped off by workers.

Six Flags Over Georgia said it was "deeply saddened by the guest incident at our park today. Our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with the guest's family, friends, and loved ones."

Officials have not said how the person was killed. The BBC has contacted local police and fire authorities, as well as park officials.

Witnesses told local media they saw a man ejected from the ride, accounts that the BBC has not verified.

Local outlet 11Alive quoted a witness saying the man fell from the rollercoaster on to the roof of a haunted house attraction.

A park spokesperson said in a statement that its team and local authorities had responded immediately, and they were co-operating on an investigation into the incident.

Mableton Mayor Michael Owens said the city's public safety director was co-ordinating with local police and park security on the situation.

The Goliath ride opened in 2006, and it has an elevation of 200ft (60m), a 170ft plunge, a 540-degree spiral, and a speed of up to 70mph (112km/h), according to the park website. On its "thrill scale", Six Flags ranks Goliath at level four out of five.

Six Flags is the largest amusement park operator in North America, with 20 amusement parks, 14 water parks and nine resorts across Canada, the US and Mexico.

The incident comes just weeks after one of its parks in southern California announced it would close the popular X2 roller coaster after more than 100 people alleged brain injuries from the ride.

Six Flags said the ride had passed a range of safety tests, but that it had decided to retire it because it was "the right thing to do".

articles.title: Pro wrestler's reference to deadly Saudi airport attack during match entrance costs him job at TNA Wrestling
articles.summary: Max Caster's Bound for Glory rap referenced the Riyadh airport attack, prompting TNA to ban him and scrub all related content from social media.
articles.body: Total Nonstop Action Wrestling’s (TNA) pay-per-view Bound for Glory was an exhilarating ride that saw multiple championships change hands, including the world championship in the main event. One moment, however, left the company with a bitter taste in its mouth. CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK PRO WRESTLING COVERAGE Pro wrestler Max Caster made his TNA debut in a match against Moose. It was his first match after he had a run with All Elite Wrestling (AEW) and it appeared he was going to be a mainstay on the roster. Caster, who is known for performing a rap song during his ring entrance, brought the rhymes with him. In one lyric, Caster made mention of the attack at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh in Saudi Arabia over the weekend that left more than a dozen dead. The Iran-backed Houthis claimed responsibility for the attack, raising tensions even further in the Middle East. "… And it’s the firing squad. I drop bombs. You don’t even have to fly to Riyadh," he said. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! Caster got immediate backlash on social media for the mention. On Monday, TNA said it deleted everything related to Caster from its social media and will no longer welcome Caster at its company. "During Sunday’s Bound for Glory pay-per-view, insensitive comments were made by Max Caster referencing attacks in Riyadh that killed and injured many people," the company said in a statement. "Making light of violent attacks is wrong. This should never have made it into the show, and that responsibility is ours. Our thoughts are with the victims, their families and everyone affected. We sincerely apologize. "We have removed the segment from replays and our social channels and are taking steps to ensure something like this never happens again. articles.title: Houthi missile attack targets Saudi capital Riyadh for third day in a row
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia claims it downed a ballistic missile fired at Riyadh, as the Houthis say they targeted King Khalid airport.
articles.body:
The Saudi Arabia-led coalition fighting in Yemen has said its forces intercepted another ballistic missile launched by the Houthis towards the Saudi capital, Riyadh, as the city reels from attacks that have killed at least 14 people in recent days.

In a statement on X, Turki Al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the coalition, said the Houthis fired one ballistic missile at Riyadh and two towards Khamis Mushait, a city in the southwest.

All three were “intercepted and destroyed”, he said.

Residents of Riyadh reported several powerful explosions on Monday night, moments after a text message to their phones warned of an aerial threat.

The Houthis, who control Yemen’s most populous areas, including the capital, Sanaa, said their target in Riyadh had been King Khalid International airport.

Yahya Saree, a Houthi military spokesman, said the group had also sent a drone towards a military airbase at Khamis Mushait, near the Yemeni border. He again warned international airlines and travellers “against operating flights to airports” in Saudi Arabia, except in the holy cities of Mecca and Medina, saying the facilities were “unsafe”.

The renewed attacks came as King Khalid International airport in Riyadh remains closed after a Houthi attack on Saturday that killed at least 13 people and wounded more than 300 others. Another strike on Sunday killed one person and wounded 11.

Saudi authorities said the airport would remain closed until this Saturday, and airlines have canceled flights. The Houthis have also struck Saudi oil facilities.

The attacks come as the Houthis fight forces aligned with Yemen’s internationally recognised government for control of the country. The Saudi-led coalition has carried out an air campaign against the Houthis and backed the government’s ground forces. The fighting erupted amid regional tensions set off by the United States and Israel’s war on Iran.

Speaking at an energy conference in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia’s Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud said the attacks on airports over the last week have tested the kingdom’s resilience.

“The events of recent weeks are serious,” the minister said. “Our response must be equally serious.” He added that Vision 2030, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s plan to diversify the Saudi economy, “must continue. Investment must continue”.

Saudi authorities have meanwhile opened an investigation into why the country’s air defences failed to stop the barrage, according to two regional officials who spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity. An initial inquiry found that the Houthis first launched several drones to clear a path for a mix of cruise and ballistic missiles, which then reached the airport, the officials said.

The Houthis possess ballistic missiles with warheads that can change direction in flight, posing a challenge to the Patriot interceptors and other systems the Saudis rely on.

One official told AP that investigators also wanted to know why the defences had not given earlier warning of an attack in which missiles and drones flew more than 1,000km, or 620 miles, to reach Riyadh.

US President Donald Trump separately criticised the Houthis but gave no indication that Washington would intervene. “Well, the Houthis are misbehaving very badly. No good,” he told reporters when asked what he planned to do about the group.

A Houthi official warned that US involvement would bring retaliation.

“If the US becomes involved in the aggression against Yemen, we will not deliberate over the decision to respond; rather, there will be a swift and painful response targeting the US and all its interests in the region,” Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, a member of the Houthis’ political bureau, told the AFP news agency.

Al-Bukhaiti also warned “all employees and workers at Saudi oil facilities and airports to stay away from these sites, as they have become legitimate targets”.

The attacks have put events scheduled in Riyadh this month under pressure, including the kingdom’s flagship investment conference and the WPC Energy Congress, where several top oil executives were dropped from the programme.

The United Arab Emirates’s national carrier Etihad Airways announced on Monday that it was cancelling all flights to and from Riyadh until next week. It also suspended flights to Dammam and Jeddah.

Bahrain’s national carrier Gulf Air said it, too, was cancelling all Riyadh flights until Saturday.

US operator Delta announced it would delay the launch of direct flights from Atlanta to Riyadh, scheduled for October 23.

articles.title: Papa Leão XIV será internado nesta terça para remover nódulo | G1
articles.standfirst: Pontífice anunciou no domingo (11) que médicos detectaram um nódulo em seu pulmão. Vaticano não informou nem se nódulo é benigno ou maligno, nem se viagem que papa tem para a América Latina em novembro será mantida.
articles.summary: O papa Leão XIV será internado nesta terça-feira (13) em um hospital de Roma para uma operação de retirada de nódulo no pulmão. A cirurgia foi anunciada pelo próprio papa.
articles.body:
O papa Leão XIV será internado nesta terça-feira (13) em um hospital de Roma para uma operação de retirada de nódulo. A cirurgia, anunciada há apenas dois dias, foi recomendada após médicos detectaram uma lesão em seu pulmão.

➡️ No domingo (11), o pontífice surpreendeu fiéis ao anunciar , durante uma oração na Praça de São Pedro, no Vaticano , que médicos detectarem um nódulo em seu pulmão "em estágio inicial" . Leão XIV disse que operação ocorreria nos "próximos dias".

Nem o Vaticano, nem o papa informaram a natureza do nódulo. Pesquisas sugerem que a maioria dos nódulos detectados em exames de rotina e sem estar associados a sintomas, costuma ser benigna .

O pontífice, de 71 anos, não tem nenhum outro problema de saúde conhecido.

O pontífice afirmou que o nódulo foi detectado em estágio inicial e seu crescimento está "bem controlado" . Ainda assim, afirmou o papa, médicos recomendaram a cirurgia para a remoção .

“Queridos amigos, durante alguns exames médicos recentes, os médicos encontraram um nódulo localizado em meu pulmão. Ele foi detectado em um estágio muito inicial e está bem localizado. Os médicos consideram a cirurgia adequada. Seguindo a orientação deles, decidi, portanto, submeter-me a uma operação para removê-lo. A cirurgia já está agendada para os próximos dias. Agradeço pela proximidade espiritual de vocês e confio-me às suas orações", disse o papa aos fiéis.

O porta-voz do Vaticano, Matteo Bruni, não deu detalhes do exame , mas afirmou que recuperação do pontífice após a cirurgia deverá levar cerca de uma semana. Por isso, na segunda-feira o papa cancelou toda a sua agenda de atividades até 20 de outubro .

O anúncio também suscitou questionamentos sobre se Leão XIV, que é dos Estados Unidos mas viveu 20 anos no Peru, manterá a viagem que tem programada para a América Latina. A visita, no que inclui Peru, Uruguai e Argentina, está prevista para ocorrer no início de novembro e durará quase duas semanas.

Papa Leão XIV durante oração dominical — Foto: Filippo Monteforte / AFP

O Vaticano não informou se a viagem está mantida ou será cancelada. No entanto, na oração no domingo na qual o pontífice fez o anúncio, ele fez referência à viagem, agradecendo a fiéis por orações "pela viagem pastoral que eu farei" .

Também não havia informações, até a última atualização desta reportagem, sobre o atual estado do pontífice, que tem 71 anos e não apresenta nenhum outro problema de saúde conhecido. Ele costuma se exercitar durante a semana, segundo o Vaticano. O pontífice faz natação e joga tênis .

👉 De origem norte-americana, Robert Prevost foi eleito papa em maio de 2025, substituindo o papa Francisco, argentino, que morreu em abril do ano passado após uma série de problemas de saúde.

Jornalistas aguardamem frente à Basílica de São Pedro, no Vaticano, em 12 de outubro de 2026. — Foto: Yara Nardi/ Reuters

articles.body:
O papa Leão XIV será internado nesta terça-feira (13) para uma operação para retirar um nódulo no pulmão.

➡️ No domingo (11), o pontífice do 71 anos anunciou, no fim da tradicional bênção na Praça de São Pedro, que médicos detectaram um nódulo em seu pulmão "em estágio inicial" e recomendaram a cirurgia.️

➡️ Um nódulo pulmonar é uma massa densa encontrada no pulmão. A maioria dos nódulos detectados em exames, sem estar associados a sintomas, costuma ser benigna. A operação também poderá funcionar como uma biópsia.

A cirurgia exigirá uma semana de recuperação no hospital, e o Vaticano cancelou nesta segunda-feira (12) todas as audiências do papa até o dia 20 de outubro.

Durante o período de internação, Leão XIV deverá continuar governando a Igreja a partir do hospital, como já ocorreu com outros pontífices.

Nesta segunda, à véspera de sua internação, a rotina do papa seguiu normalmente.

O pontífice presidiu uma audiência com integrantes de uma instituição beneficente sediada em Roma, o Circolo San Pietro, e recebeu uma doação do grupo. Ele falou com voz forte e clara, elogiando o trabalho e o sacrifício dos integrantes. Ao final, foi recebido com uma calorosa salva de palmas.

À tarde, esperava-se que ele voltasse a participar de uma conferência de uma semana, convocada por ele, sobre o trabalho pastoral com as famílias. Mas, à noite, os dois organizadores da conferência divulgaram um comunicado informando que, diante da ausência de Leão XIV, mudariam os planos e adiariam a publicação da declaração final do encontro até depois de sua recuperação.

Papa Leão XIV faz benção dominical na Praça de São Pedro no Vaticano — Foto: Gregorio Borgia/AP

Ao anunciar a cirurgia, o pontífice afirmou que o nódulo foi detectado em estágio inicial e que seu crescimento está "bem controlado" . Ainda assim, afirmou o papa, médicos recomendaram a cirurgia para a remoção .

“Queridos amigos, durante alguns exames médicos recentes, os médicos encontraram um nódulo localizado em meu pulmão. Ele foi detectado em um estágio muito inicial e está bem localizado. Os médicos consideram a cirurgia adequada. Seguindo a orientação deles, decidi, portanto, submeter-me a uma operação para removê-lo. A cirurgia já está agendada para os próximos dias. Agradeço pela proximidade espiritual de vocês e confio-me às suas orações", disse Leão XIV aos fiéis.

O porta-voz do papa não informou se o pontífice seguirá com a sua agenda depois do repouso pós-operação.

Leão XIV tem uma viagem de duas semanas, no início de novembro, para a América Latina , a primeira que fará ao continente. Pela previsão, ele visitará Uruguai, Argentina e Peru, país em que viveu por mais de 20 anos.

No Angelus, a oração de domingo na qual o pontífice fez o anúncio, ele fez referência à viagem, mantendo intenções de realizá-la.

O pontífice costuma se exercitar durante a semana, segundo o Vaticano. Ele faz natação e joga tênis , e não há registro de que seja fumante ou de que tenha tido problemas de saúde recentemente.

De origem norte-americana, Robert Prevost foi eleito papa em maio de 2025, substituindo o papa Francisco, que morreu em abril do ano passado após uma série de problemas de saúde.

articles.body:
Bombeiros e policiais se reúnem do lado de fora do local onde várias pessoas ficaram feridas em um ataque a faca em Incheon, Coreia do Sul. — Foto: Yonhap via Reuters

Oito pessoas ficaram feridas em um ataque a faca em um supermercado na cidade de Incheon, na Coreia do Sul , na terça-feira (13). Uma pessoa sofreu uma parada cardíaca, informou a polícia.

Incheon, a oeste de Seul, abriga o principal aeroporto da Coreia do Sul e faz parte da região metropolitana de Seul.

A Coreia do Sul foi abalada por uma série de ataques com faca em 2023, incluindo atentados que deixaram várias pessoas mortas e feridas.

Mais recentemente, em maio, uma jovem de 17 anos foi fatalmente esfaqueada e outro adolescente ficou ferido na cidade de Gwangju, no sudoeste do país, por um homem na casa dos 20 anos, que posteriormente foi condenado à prisão perpétua.

articles.title: Chuva no RS: Rio Uruguai sobe e Inmet alerta para novos temporais | G1
articles.standfirst: Instabilidade se concentra no Norte e no Litoral nesta terça-feira. Volumes de chuva podem chegar a 100 milímetros por dia, com risco de corte de energia e alagamentos, segundo o Inmet.
articles.summary: Chuva no Rio Grande do Sul deve atingir 100mm nesta terça, trazendo risco de alagamentos e ventos fortes em regiões com o Rio Uruguai acima da cota de inundação.
articles.body:
O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia (Inmet) e a Defesa Civil Estadual emitiram alertas para o risco de temporais, queda de granizo e ventos de até 100 km/h no Rio Grande do Sul nesta terça-feira (13/10). O aviso classificado como "perigo" abrange as regiões Serrana, Noroeste e Nordeste . A chuva prevista agrava a situação hidrológica do estado, que já registra rios acima da cota de inundação .

Nesta terça-feira, a instabilidade fica mais concentrada no Norte e no Litoral gaúcho. De acordo com o Inmet, os volumes de chuva podem atingir entre 50 e 100 milímetros por dia .

A Defesa Civil destaca que as rajadas de vento podem superar os 80 km/h no Norte e Nordeste, principalmente entre a tarde e a noite . O Inmet adverte para o risco de corte de energia elétrica, estragos em plantações, queda de árvores e alagamentos.

Previsão de tempestade para terça-feira (13) no RS — Foto: Divulgação/ Inmet

O Centro de Monitoramento da Defesa Civil informou que o rio Uruguai permanece acima da cota de inundação a partir de São Borja , com os maiores riscos concentrados no trecho até Uruguaiana. Novas elevações no rio Uruguai, a partir da cidade de Iraí, além de cheias em arroios e pequenos rios , são esperadas após as chuvas desta terça-feira.

Na Região Metropolitana de Porto Alegre , a previsão para a terça-feira indica pancadas de chuva e trovoadas, com o sol aparecendo entre muitas nuvens à tarde . As temperaturas variam entre 16°C e 21°C .

A tendência para quarta-feira (14) é de aumento da instabilidade à tarde e à noite no extremo Norte, Nordeste e Litoral Norte , com chuva moderada a forte e possibilidade de temporais isolados. Nas demais regiões, o tempo terá variação de nuvens, com chance de chuviscos ou chuva fraca .

Na quinta-feira (15), a chuva começa cedo no Norte e pode alcançar outras áreas do estado ao longo do dia . A previsão aponta maior instabilidade no Norte e no Oeste da Região Sul.

O tempo instável segue na capital na quarta e na quinta-feira, com variação de nebulosidade e chance de novas pancadas de chuva.

Rio Uruguai transbordou em Uruguaiana, na Fronteira Oeste do RS, e atingiu casas — Foto: Reprodução/RBS TV

articles.title: Caso de menina de 3 anos que morreu após ser atingida por trave de futebol solta é o terceiro do ano do Paraná | G1
articles.standfirst: Heloise da Silva Cruz estava em festa em comemoração ao Dia das Crianças quando a estrutura caiu em cima dela. Os dois outros casos aconteceram no primeiro semestre, dentro de escolas.
articles.summary: Heloise da Silva Cruz estava em festa em comemoração ao Dia das Crianças quando a estrutura caiu em cima dela. Os dois outros casos aconteceram no primeiro semestre, em escolas.
articles.body:
O caso da menina de 3 anos que morreu após ser atingida por uma trave de futebol solta em Imbaú , nos Campos Gerais do Paraná, é o terceiro registrado neste ano no Paraná.

Heloise da Silva Cruz estava participando de uma festa em comemoração ao Dia das Crianças neste domingo (11) quando a estrutura caiu em cima dela. Ela foi socorrida pelos pais e encaminhada a uma unidade de saúde, mas não resistiu aos ferimentos. Relembre detalhes mais abaixo.

Os outros dois casos aconteceram no primeiro semestre, em escolas da região central do Paraná.

O primeiro foi em fevereiro, em uma escola municipal rural de Marquinho . A vítima tinha 7 anos de idade. Segundo a Prefeitura, o menino estava com a turma realizando atividades na quadra de esportes quando se pendurou na trave, que tombou sobre ele. Relembre neste link .

O outro foi em abril, em uma escola particular de Prudentópolis . Sofia Aparecida Iaciuk, de 3 anos, foi atingida pela trave após outras crianças se pendurarem no equipamento durante uma atividade recreativa na quadra. Socorristas passaram uma hora tentando reanimá-la, mas ela não resistiu. Relembre neste link .

Sofia Aparecida Iaciuk e Heloise da Silva Cruz tinham 3 anos de idade — Foto: Reprodução

Situação aconteceu em campo comunitário de futebol, em Imbaú — Foto: Google Street View

Pelo menos outros quatro casos foram registrados no estado nos últimos cinco anos.

Em novembro de 2025 Eliedson Maciel dos Santos, de 12 anos, estava em um treino de futsal em Ibema (oeste) quando, segundo a prefeitura, se pendurou na trave e ela caiu sobre ele.

Em julho de 2025 Alan José Rodrigues, de 13 anos, morreu após ser atingido na cabeça por uma trave de futebol enquanto jogava bola em uma aldeia indígena de Chopinzinho (sudoeste).

Em dezembro de 2024 Sofia Barbosa Bonetti, de 6 anos, morreu após ser atingida por uma trave de futebol enquanto brincava com o próprio irmão na zona rural de Realeza (sudoeste).

Em outubro de 2022 , Kauan Felipe Teixeira, de 14 anos, morreu na própria festa de aniversário depois de ser atingido no tórax por uma trave enquanto brincava em um campo de futebol em Ponta Grossa (Campos Gerais).

Heloise da Silva Cruz tinha 3 anos de idade — Foto: Cedida pela família

articles.title: ‘Mudanças climáticas’ ou ‘mudança climática’? Por que a diferença entre singular e plural faz diferença | G1
articles.standfirst: Nas línguas latinas, a expressão no plural é a mais corrente. Mas no singular, como foi criada em1975, expressa mais rigor e clareza na definição do fenômeno como um todo
articles.summary: Nas línguas latinas, a expressão no plural é a mais corrente. Mas no singular, como foi criada em1975, expressa mais rigor e clareza na definição do fenômeno como um todo
articles.body:
Numa das minhas primeiras visitas ao Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia (INPA), fui imediatamente corrigido pelo professor Niro Higuchi, uma referência nacional em floresta Amazônica, quando usei a expressão “mudanças climáticas”. “Não use o plural. O correto é ‘mudança climática’, ensinou. Minha primeira reação foi pensar que tudo não passava de preciosismo. Um excesso acadêmico, certamente. Mas depois aprendi que esta sutil diferença carrega uma importante mensagem que faz toda a diferença.

O artigo do geoquímico Wallace Broecker, publicado em 1975 na revista Science, intitulado Climatic Change: Are We on the Brink of a Pronounced Global Warming? ”, chamou atenção para uma alteração de estado no sistema terrestre. O uso da expressão “ climate change ” no singular refletia a visão termodinâmica e física de uma transição de um equilíbrio climático para outro.

Wallace Smith Broecker (1931–2019) foi um dos mais influentes geoquímicos e paleoclimatologistas do século XX. Professor da Universidade de Columbia e pesquisador no renomado Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory , Broecker dedicou sua carreira a desvendar o papel dos oceanos na regulação climática, sendo o pioneiro a conceituar a Circulação Termoalina Global (correntes oceânicas profundas) e a demonstrar que o clima da Terra pode sofrer mudanças abruptas e não lineares.

O artigo de 1975 surgiu em um momento de intenso debate e aparente contradição científica. Entre as décadas de 1940 e o início dos anos 1970, os registros meteorológicos globais indicavam um leve resfriamento nas temperaturas médias da superfície terrestre. Esse declínio temporário alimentou especulações na imprensa e entre alguns cientistas sobre a iminência de uma nova era glacial, ofuscando as preocupações com as emissões de dióxido de carbono decorrentes da queima de combustíveis fósseis.

Broecker demonstrou no artigo que o resfriamento observado nas décadas anteriores não anulava o aquecimento global, mas decorria de uma combinação entre a poluição por aerossóis e ciclos naturais de resfriamento em escala multidecadal, identificados a partir de amostras de gelo da Groenlândia ( Camp Century ).

No artigo, ele argumentou que essa fase de arrefecimento natural estava mascarando o aquecimento gerado pelo aumento exponencial do dióxido de carbono (CO₂) atmosférico. Assim que esse ciclo natural revertesse de fase, o efeito estufa antropogênico dominaria o balanço térmico do planeta.

Com notável precisão, Broecker previu que nas primeiras décadas após a virada do século XXI, o planeta entraria em uma trajetória de aquecimento pronunciado. Além de seus cálculos, o artigo entrou para a história por popularizar a expressão global warming (aquecimento global), deslocando a atenção da comunidade internacional para os riscos da intervenção humana no equilíbrio termodinâmico global.

Conceitualmente, expressão surgiu no singular

Quando o tema ganhou a arena diplomática no final da década de 1980, o singular continuou a ser a norma nos documentos oficiais. Em 1988, a Assembleia Geral da ONU aprovou a histórica Resolução 43/53, que tinha como título “Proteção do clima global para as gerações presentes e futuras”. A resolução chamava a atenção para que a conservação do clima fosse entendida como uma importante herança para as futuras gerações.

Aqui, vale destacar a diferença entre tempo e clima. Tanto o trabalho de Broecker quanto a resolução da ONU trazem o clima como elemento central. De certa forma, para a grande maioria das pessoas, a sensação diária expressa pelo tempo acaba sendo muito mais relevante que a compreensão a longo prazo determinada pelo clima…

Enquanto o tempo ( weather ) corresponde às condições e eventos atmosféricos de curto prazo que ocorrem a cada dia (como chuva, vento e oscilações diárias de temperatura). O clima ( climate ) descreve o padrão e o comportamento médio dessas condições em uma determinada região ao longo de um extenso período temporal. Tradicionalmente, o clima é analisado por meio de médias de 30 anos (conhecidas como Normais Climatológicas). Esta concepção de longo prazo molda, como veremos a seguir, a ideia de uma mudança de padrão climático.

Na esteira da Resolução 43/53, os tratados multilaterais da Rio-92 consolidaram a expressão jurídica no singular. Como pode ser visto na criação da United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC, em português: Convenção-Quadro das Nações Unidas sobre a Mudança do Clima).

Na língua inglesa, a palavra change da expressão climate change é tratada como um substantivo incontável. A forma no plural, climate changes , soa estranha, não idiomática, e é raramente empregada na literatura técnica ou na imprensa anglófona. Por outro lado, em línguas latinas, notadamente o português, o uso do plural começou a ganhar força a partir da década de 1990, impulsionado pela divulgação dos relatórios do IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, criado em 1988 ).

Essa divergência entre os idiomas decorre fundamentalmente de características gramaticais e semânticas próprias da tradição latina. Em português (mudanças climáticas), espanhol ( cambios climáticos ) e francês ( changements climatiques ), o substantivo derivado do latim é eminentemente contável. Esses idiomas têm uma tendência natural a pluralizar conceitos abstratos para descrever suas manifestações práticas, dinâmicas e empíricas.

Quando tratados e relatórios da ONU e do IPCC começaram a ser traduzidos do inglês para as línguas latinas no final dos anos 1980 e ao longo dos anos 1990, os tradutores e cientistas naturalmente adotaram o plural para sinalizar que o fenômeno não era apenas uma alteração única de temperatura, mas sim um conjunto amplo e interconectado de perturbações (regimes de chuva, ventos, eventos extremos, nível do mar).

Curiosamente, a diplomacia estrita e o direito internacional, optaram por espelhar o singular do inglês de forma literal: por exemplo, na tradução de IPCC: Convenção-Quadro das Nações Unidas sobre a Mudança do Clima. No entanto, fora desse nicho jurídico, o plural popularizou-se.

No Brasil, a transição e a popularização do plural “mudanças climáticas” ocorreram de forma marcante ao longo da década de 2000. Durante toda a década de 1990, o debate público e governamental no país esteve fortemente condicionado pelo vocabulário diplomático herdado da Rio-92.

Nesse período inicial, os círculos governamentais, o Ministério do Meio Ambiente e a diplomacia do Itamaraty utilizavam quase exclusivamente o singular, espelhando o texto da Convenção-Quadro da ONU. O tema ainda circulava restrito a fóruns multilaterais e a grupos especializados, onde o foco recaía sobre o balanço radiativo global como um processo termodinâmico único.

O cenário começou a mudar quando o debate extravasou os gabinetes diplomáticos e ganhou as redações dos grandes jornais, as ONGs socioambientais e os programas de pós-graduação multidisciplinares. Eventos climáticos de grande repercussão na época, como o Furacão Catarina em 2004 e a seca histórica na Amazônia em 2005, somados ao impacto da divulgação do 4º Relatório do IPCC (AR4) e ao documentário “Uma Verdade Inconveniente” em 2007, geraram uma explosão de cobertura midiática. A imprensa brasileira e a divulgação científica adotaram o plural “mudanças climáticas” para traduzir a diversidade de impactos perceptíveis no cotidiano da população, como secas, enchentes, ondas de calor e perdas agrícolas.

A consagração do plural na comunidade científica brasileira ficou evidente na institucionalização das grandes redes de fomento e pesquisa criadas no fim daquela década. Em 2007, o Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação estruturou a Rede CLIMA (formalizada como Rede Brasileira de Pesquisas sobre Mudanças Climáticas Globais), e, em 2008, a FAPESP lançou seu Programa de Pesquisa em Mudanças Climáticas Globais.

A partir desse momento, estabeleceu-se a divisão que persiste até hoje no país. A esfera estritamente jurídica e legal manteve o singular por tradição formal, como na Lei Federal 12.187/2009, que instituiu a Política Nacional sobre Mudança do Clima (PNMC). O meio acadêmico (de modo geral), a imprensa, as organizações civis e o público geral consolidaram o plural como a forma espontânea de comunicação.

Por que aexpressão no singular é cientificamente mais correta

Aqui, gostaria de defender o uso do termo no singular: mudança climática ou mudança do clima. É fundamental apresentar o fenômeno como um processo integrado, sistêmico e termodinamicamente unificado, superando a fragmentação perceptiva que o plural muitas vezes induz.

Do ponto de vista da física do sistema Terra, o que a humanidade enfrenta não é uma multiplicidade desconexa de fenômenos climáticos isolados. Mas sim uma alteração global do estado de equilíbrio do balanço de energia do planeta. Ao utilizar o singular, reforça-se o caráter estrutural e matricial do problema: o acúmulo de gases de efeito estufa na atmosfera altera a retenção de radiação infravermelha, gerando um desequilíbrio radiativo contínuo.

O uso do plural (mudanças climáticas) tende a direcionar o foco cognitivo e comunicacional para as consequências locais e episódicas, como secas em uma bacia hidrográfica, enchentes em outra região, elevação do nível do mar ou variações sazonais de temperatura.

Embora vitais para a avaliação de risco e mitigação de perdas, esses eventos são manifestações empíricas e sintomas de uma causa subjacente única. Tratar o macroprocesso no singular resgata a causalidade primária e evita que o debate público trate alterações hidrológicas, meteorológicas e térmicas como crises paralelas ou desarticuladas.

A discussão entre singular ou plural, como eu inicialmente pensei, não é um mero rigor acadêmico. Adotar o singular, portanto, confere rigor e clareza ao discurso. Estabelece que o que estamos observando é uma transformação profunda e singular na termodinâmica que sustenta a biosfera terrestre.

Eric Bastos Gorgens é bolsista Produtividade do CNPq, coordena e participa de projetos de pesquisa na área florestal financiados pelo CNPq e pela FAPEMIG.

articles.summary: Edital oferece 66 vagas imediatas e 118 para cadastro de reserva em diferentes áreas; inscrições começam em 15 de outubro.
articles.body:
Câmara dos Deputados — Foto: Divulgação / Câmara dos Deputados

O novo concurso da Câmara dos Deputados reúne alguns dos principais atrativos buscados por candidatos ao serviço público: remuneração acima da média, estabilidade e oportunidades em áreas que vão da comunicação social à engenharia.

Ao todo, o edital oferece 66 vagas imediatas e outras 118 para cadastro de reserva na carreira de analista legislativo, com salários de R$ 32.070,88.

🔎 Há oportunidades para jornalistas, relações-públicas, arquivistas, bibliotecários, museólogos e engenheiros, além de vagas para uma especialidade pouco conhecida do grande público, mas que concentra a maior oferta do edital: Registro e Redação.

As inscrições poderão ser feitas entre 15 de outubro e 17 de novembro , pelo site do Cebraspe, banca responsável pela seleção. A taxa de inscrição é de R$ 130.

Mas as dúvidas sobre o concurso vão muito além do período de cadastro. Por isso, o g1 preparou um guia com os principais pontos do edital. Abaixo, entenda:

Quando os aprovados poderão ser convocados?

Embora todas as vagas pertençam à carreira de analista legislativo , o concurso não é destinado a um único perfil profissional.

Um dos destaques do edital é que a especialidade com maior número de vagas não exige formação superior específica.

A área de Registro e Redação oferece 25 vagas imediatas e outras 25 para cadastro de reserva. Para concorrer, basta possuir diploma de curso superior reconhecido pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC), independentemente da área de formação.

Já as demais oportunidades são destinadas a candidatos com graduações específicas.

O novo concurso da Câmara dos Deputados — Foto: g1

Independentemente da especialidade escolhida, todos os aprovados ingressarão na carreira com remuneração inicial de R$ 32.070,88 .

Os servidores serão lotados em Brasília, onde está localizada a sede da Câmara dos Deputados.

Além do salário, os ocupantes do cargo terão acesso aos benefícios oferecidos pela Casa e às garantias previstas para os servidores efetivos da administração pública federal.

Além da formação exigida para cada especialidade, os candidatos deverão atender aos requisitos legais para ingresso no serviço público federal.

ter nacionalidade brasileira ou portuguesa, nos casos previstos em lei;

estar em dia com as obrigações eleitorais;

estar quite com as obrigações militares, quando aplicável;

possuir aptidão física e mental para o exercício do cargo;

apresentar a documentação exigida para a posse;

possuir a graduação exigida para a especialidade escolhida.

Algumas áreas também exigem registro profissional no respectivo conselho de classe.

Embora todos os aprovados ingressem na carreira de analista legislativo, as atividades desempenhadas variam de acordo com a especialidade escolhida.

Os profissionais da área de Divulgação Institucional atuam na criação de campanhas, ações educativas e projetos de comunicação voltados à população.

Os jornalistas são responsáveis pela cobertura das atividades parlamentares, produção de reportagens, notícias, entrevistas e conteúdos para os diversos veículos de comunicação da Câmara.

Já os relações-públicas trabalham na organização de eventos, cerimônias, ações de relacionamento institucional e iniciativas voltadas ao fortalecimento da imagem da Casa.

Na área de gestão da informação , os arquivistas organizam e preservam documentos produzidos ao longo de décadas de atividade legislativa.

Os bibliotecários administram acervos e auxiliam em pesquisas técnicas utilizadas por parlamentares e servidores. Os museólogos, por sua vez, cuidam da preservação da memória institucional e dos bens históricos relacionados ao Poder Legislativo.

As especialidades de engenharia têm atribuições ligadas à manutenção e modernização da infraestrutura da Câmara. Os profissionais participam da elaboração de projetos, fiscalização de obras, emissão de pareceres técnicos e acompanhamento de contratos.

Já os servidores de Registro e Redação exercem uma das funções mais diretamente ligadas ao processo legislativo. Eles são responsáveis pelo registro oficial de debates, pronunciamentos e sessões parlamentares, além da elaboração, revisão e organização de documentos produzidos pela Casa.

As provas estão marcadas para 17 de janeiro de 2027 .

A aplicação ocorrerá nas 26 capitais brasileiras e no Distrito Federal. Dessa forma, os candidatos poderão realizar os exames em seus próprios estados, sem a necessidade de viajar para Brasília.

➡️ As avaliações serão aplicadas em dois turnos. Os horários definitivos serão divulgados posteriormente pelo Cebraspe.

A seleção será composta por prova objetiva e prova discursiva, ambas aplicadas no mesmo dia.

A prova objetiva terá 180 itens no formato "certo" ou "errado", distribuídos entre conhecimentos gerais e conhecimentos específicos.

Já a prova discursiva será voltada para conteúdos relacionados à especialidade escolhida pelo candidato.

A Câmara dos Deputados poderá iniciar as nomeações após a homologação do resultado final do concurso. Segundo o cronograma oficial, a divulgação do resultado final está prevista para 30 de abril de 2027 .

A partir dessa data, as nomeações poderão ocorrer de acordo com as necessidades da administração e a disponibilidade de vagas.

Além dos candidatos classificados dentro das vagas imediatas, aprovados no cadastro de reserva também poderão ser convocados durante o período de validade do concurso, que será de dois anos - contados a partir da homologação do resultado final.

Esse prazo poderá ser prorrogado uma única vez, por igual período. Isso significa que a Câmara dos Deputados poderá convocar aprovados por até quatro anos, conforme suas necessidades administrativas.

O concurso prevê 118 oportunidades para cadastro de reserva, mecanismo utilizado para formar uma lista de candidatos aptos a serem convocados futuramente. Ou seja, quem for aprovado para o cadastro de reserva não tem direito à nomeação imediata.

Esses candidatos ficam em uma espécie de lista de espera e podem ser chamados caso surjam novas vagas, ocorram aposentadorias, exonerações ou haja necessidade de reforçar o quadro de servidores durante o período de validade do concurso.

A convocação segue a ordem de classificação e pode ocorrer a qualquer momento enquanto o concurso estiver válido.

articles.title: 'I lost my hair to MS - now now my wigs are worn by Serena Williams and Naomi Campbell
articles.summary: Antonia Okonma Shittu's wig business was launched after a shock diagnosis, and she now wants to help other women feel their best.
articles.body:
When Antonia Okonma Shittu was told she had multiple sclerosis (MS) and would be using a wheelchair within the year, she was in denial.

The 26-year-old, who was in between acting jobs and working in a call centre, said the diagnosis was a "massive turning point" in her life.

"It does really make you think about what you want to do in life," she said.

She looked back to what she enjoyed doing as a child - styling hair - and decided to use the shock of the diagnosis to spur her on to turn her passion into a business.

Antonia, who grew up on a council estate in west London, bought two wigs and went door to door selling them from the boot of her car.

Almost two decades later, she is now a multi-million-pound brand owner, with high-profile clients including tennis icon Serena Williams, model Naomi Campbell and actress Niecey Nash. She even won a Black British Business Award last week .

Antonia, now 44, still struggles with her health, having also received diagnoses of Graves' disease - an autoimmune condition - and heart failure, but hopes her experience running a hair empire while fitting in hospital appointments can inspire other women.

'I didn't feel like myself after losing my hair'

Antonia says she saw a gap in the market when she was surrounded by "terrible" wigs while working in TV and film, including in the ITV series Bad Girls two decades ago.

"Women wanted natural-looking wigs and they just weren't available. They looked like helmets!"

Antonia set up a Facebook page and began advertising on Gumtree. "I had very limited resources. I didn't have any investors behind me. I come from very humble beginnings."

Her experience dealing with MS has helped her success, she says. Antonia lost her hair when she underwent chemotherapy following a bone marrow transplant, so she knows what it is like to be "completely bald".

This made her relate more deeply to her customers, she explains, as she understands the loss of control some women feel when they lose their hair.

"I didn't feel like myself," she says, "but being able to put on a wig that looks something close to how your hair was, or the look you used to have, it's as though you can feel like yourself again."

When she sees a woman put a wig on and her "whole face lights up", it can be "very, very rewarding".

"When we feel good about ourselves...we're more confident, we can achieve more. I felt like I was changing the world, one person at a time."

While Antonia's business, A-List Lace Hair, has grown from strength to strength, with salons in London and New York, she has been dealing with the impact of her health conditions.

She struggles with fatigue due to her MS and uses a wheelchair, but says this has not stopped her success. Instead, it has simply changed the way she has run her business.

"I used to feel that being a good entrepreneur was being able to do as much as I can myself," Antonia said.

"Due to my health challenges, there are days where I literally can't feel my legs, they feel like jelly, there's days where I'm completely exhausted after sleeping, I wake up completely shattered."

This has forced her to "trust other people and gain strength in building a team".

As a woman in business, being in a wheelchair can sometimes make Antonia feel "smaller" as people often have to look down at her at industry events.

"People are often surprised when I start speaking about my business, as though they're thinking 'how have you accomplished all of this in a wheelchair?'"

Antonia, who has three young children, says that being underestimated can be a good thing, and she wants to remain open about her health to inspire other women.

She says she used to feel "weak" because of her disability, but now feels she has gained "so much strength" from sharing her experience online.

Asked what she would say to another woman who may fear her age, disability or health could get in the way of success, she says: "I would encourage them to just start."

"You might not have control over your health, you might not know what tomorrow is going to bring, and you might not have all the resources. But start with what you do have, and let's see what could happen next."
